title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding is a technique used to convert categorical data into a numerical format. It creates binary columns for each category. Think about whether age is a categorical variable or a continuous one. How might this affect the use of one-hot encoding?

title: Considering Age as a Continuous Variable
text: If age is treated as a continuous variable, which of the following methods would be appropriate for incorporating it into a linear model?
choices: Use age directly as a feature

title: Standardizing Continuous Variables
text: Standardizing a continuous variable involves transforming it to have a mean of $$0$$ and a standard deviation of $$1$$. This can help improve the performance of some models. Consider how this might apply to age data.

title: Using Age Directly
text: Is it reasonable to use age directly as a feature in the model without any transformation?
choices: No, age must be transformed first
Yes, age can be used directly
